highlights.description: 提出基于锥约束/梯度投影的安全策略学习框架，将奖励与安全梯度的冲突在梯度层面通过约束锥处理，并给出有限步改进保证，属于构造性建模贡献。
highlights.excerpt: More recently, a few works have instead examined the problem at the gradient level, seeking to reduce interference in policy updates by directly modifying or aggregating the reward and safety gradients
highlights.transferability: 可迁移到其他多约束安全RL算法设计，特别是梯度冲突处理环节。
highlights.limitation: 仅从摘要式描述可见梯度聚合思路，缺少对锥约束构造与有限步保证的完整推导片段。

highlights.description: 在紧急制动等安全关键基准上与CPO、PPO-Lag、P3O、CUP、FOCOPS等基线做统一horizon/更新预算及相同初始状态的对比，并保留解析停止边界作为评估参考。
highlights.excerpt: We compare CCPO with CPO, PPO-Lag, P3O, and CUP under a common horizon and update budget, and evaluate each policy from the same 15 initial states. The analytical stopping boundary and the per-state convex optimum serve only as evaluation references
highlights.transferability: 该统一预算与参考最优的评测协议可用于其他安全策略优化方法的公平对比。
highlights.limitation: 基线列表在片段间不完全一致（一处含FOCOPS另一处未列），且未提供具体数值结果。

highlights.description: 发现CAF能恢复参考可行边界，且CCPO在紧急制动中实现可行的近最优控制，并在四个安全关键基准上保持低约束违反率，属于经验性边界与实证发现。
highlights.excerpt: show that CAF recovers the reference feasible boundary and that CCPO achieves feasible near-optimal control in emergency braking. Across four safety-critical benchmarks, CCPO maintains low constraint violation rates while preserving competitive returns relative to constrained baselines.
highlights.transferability: CAF作为约束聚合信号可迁移到其他需刻画可行集的安全RL任务。
highlights.limitation: 仅为结论性陈述，缺少可分状态的定量指标与消融结果。
